new_claims.statement_short: For an independent cap-m hub H and a two-bank projected triple with pair/joint caps K2,K3, the shell probability for H+bP+c+dL+(gamma+V^2)/(2L) has coefficient G_b=K2+K2 sqrt(m log(e/|b|))+sqrt(m K2 K3), with no algebraic b-loss.
For Q_b=2HL+2bLP+V^2 under the same two-bank source hypothesis and cap-one H, ||p_Qb||_ess is O_{K2,K3}(log(e/|b|)^(1/3)) for 0<|b|<=1.

precise_missing_factor: middle Fourier annulus |b|<|zeta|<1; separate L2 hub energy and L-infinity bank-energy cap force sqrt(log(1/|b|)) by Cauchy-Schwarz. Uniformity needs extra product-sensitive characteristic-function cancellation or a physical moving-center coarea estimate.
